title: Swiggy · get help with an order safely
section: Customer care · order support and safety
content: Swiggy directs customers with order issues to the Help section in the Swiggy app and says it does not have an official customer care phone line. It warns customers not to share bank account details, UPI PIN, CVV, OTP, or card details with people claiming to be support. For an order-specific issue, use in-app Help so the support team can see the order. This source does not establish refund eligibility, delivery timing, or an outcome for a specific order; do not promise any of those. Source checked for this demo on 2026-10-23; the source page does not state a publication date.
